create_mobile_manipulator: create a MobileManipulator instance with params, agent config, and a Habitat simulator
reconfigure_mobile_manipulator: reconfigure the MobileManipulator to reload the URDF and reset joints and motors
update_mobile_manipulator: update the MobileManipulator camera transforms and check joint limits and sleep states
reset_mobile_manipulator: reset the MobileManipulator arm and gripper joint motors to their initial positions
configure_mobile_manipulator_params: configure a MobileManipulatorParams object with arm joints, gripper joints, cameras, and motor gains
